name: stance
summary: A fighting stance over a stretch of turns: take or change one, end it, or change the loadout, which ends a stance it no longer fits.

perks.description: The actor's perks; a stance needs one whose unlocks names it.

loadout.description: What the hands hold at the start, with the weapons' skills when a stance needs them.

stance.description: The stance active before the first event, if any. It must fit the loadout.

take.description: Take or change to this stance: stances.rules.turn_start_ap at the start of the actor's own turn, stances.rules.mid_turn_ap with mid_turn. Taking the active one costs nothing.

mid_turn.description: The take is not at the start of the actor's own turn.

end.description: End the active stance, for no AP.

loadout.description: The hands now hold this (a weapon drawn, dropped, or swapped); a stance it no longer fits ends.

by.description: The action that paid for the loadout change, one with changes_loadout (draw, sheathe, drop, swap); its AP after the perks' modifiers on it is the step's cost. Without it the change is free.

events.description: The steps, in order. Each needs exactly one of take, end, or loadout; more than one is an error.

stance.description: The stance active after the last event.

modifiers.description: The active stance's modifiers, to pass to combat (defender) and attack_sequence (attacker).

ended.description: The stance this step ended, replaced or no longer fitting.
